import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# Create necessary directories
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./best_submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from ./input/
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Target classes: {train_df['Cover_Type'].nunique()}")

# Identify features (exclude Id and Cover_Type for training)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
target_col = "Cover_Type"

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_df[target_col].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
test_ids = test_df["Id"].values

# FIX: Convert 1-indexed labels to 0-indexed for LightGBM (1->0, 7->6)
y_train_adj = y_train - 1

print(f"Class distribution: {dict(zip(*np.unique(y_train_adj, return_counts=True)))}")

# Split training data into train/validation (90/10)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train_adj, test_size=0.10, random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)

print(f"Training size: {X_tr.shape}")
print(f"Validation size: {X_val.shape}")

# LightGBM parameters optimized for faster training
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "max_depth": 6,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 10,
    "min_sum_hessian_in_leaf": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": RANDOM_STATE,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Early stopping parameters
n_rounds = 100
valid_rounds = 10

# Train LightGBM model
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
valid_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=n_rounds,
    valid_sets=[valid_data],
    valid_names=["valid"],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(valid_rounds, verbose=False)],
)

print(f"Model trained with {model.best_iteration} rounds")

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
y_val_pred = np.argmax(y_val_pred, axis=1)
y_val_pred = y_val_pred + 1  # Convert back to 1-indexed
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val + 1, y_val_pred)
print(f"\nHold-out validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Make predictions on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
# FIX: Use correct variable y_test_pred instead of y_val_pred
y_test_pred = np.argmax(y_test_pred, axis=1)
# FIX: Convert predictions back to 1-indexed for submission (0->1, 6->7)
y_test_pred = y_test_pred + 1

# Create submission file with correct format
# Note: sample_submission.csv has 400000 rows (0-399999), test_ids have 400000 rows
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred.astype(int)})

# Save to submission directory
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission preview:\n{submission.head()}")

# Final validation accuracy print
print(f"\nFinal validation metric: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
